newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia postpones T-bill auction until 0830 GMT.
newsitem.headline: Russia postpones T-bill auction until 0830 GMT.

text.p: The start of an auction of a new tranche of three-month GKO discount Treasury bill has been postponed to 0830 GMT from 0700 GMT, the head of the central bank securities department said on Wednesday.
The delay is to due to problems in the main server on the Moscow Interbank Curency Exchange, where the auctions and trading take place, Alexei Drugov told Reuters.
The exchange is now trying to switch operations to a reserve server, he said.
The finance ministry is offering 1.50 trillion roubles of the three-month bills (series 21070), which were first auctioned on September 4.
It is also offering 8.50 trillion roubles of new six-month bills (series 22052), and repaying six trillion roubles of mautring six-month bills (22027).
